style.value: The Word Definitions lane's adopted direction: the A59 grammar (files/a59-motion-brief.md). Independent cutout objects sized by their painted bounds on a dark void, one focal group; entries on the media clock at the spoken words (principal words rise 24 units, scale 0.82 → 1 over 0.28 s, cubic ease-out); SEMANTIC CONTINUITY as the core — an introduced object changes role as the explanation changes and the SAME object travels, never a fresh decoration per beat. For this piece the continuity carriers are already written into the script: the door (what you knock on, L2/L4 → the replaceable thing, L5) and the cook (trained for years before the restaurant opened, L4 → the thing that continues your words, L6 → retired before the definition-only close, L7). Lane authority: Hadi's #78 verdict adopted the A59 grammar for the Word Definitions lane (wd-02 exp-01, Variant B — 'more artistic'); the #77 menu ruling puts all 14 catalogue styles on the menu with a STARTING SET to develop first (cinematic typography, motion graphics, 2D graphics, whiteboard). Piece-level build notes carried from the script record: the door/cook components will be separate HTML-scene stickers (the H-01 build note, i2 §1 item 4), and the cook must never be drawn peeking or lurking (so the art does not undo the L2 verb fix).
